title: Code4Scene: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Constructing and Editing 3D Scenes
abstract: arXiv:2609.36777v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Frontier coding agents can now write and execute code that authors 3D environments, but whether they reliably understand 3D structure and precisely control scene state remains unclear. The generated 3D scene is a persistent, executable artifact: a convincing render can hide incorrect spatial relations, intersecting objects, or unintended modifications. We introduce Code4Scene, a benchmark of 190 Unreal Engine cases built from human-assembled scenes that evaluates coding agents on two complementary settings under a shared execution interface. Construction tests scene-level spatial reasoning from open-ended language specifications, where many realizations are valid; editing tests precise control of scene state, where the agent must recover the target scene from reference images while preserving everything else. Rather than scoring code or rendered views, Code4Scene evaluates the generated engine-native scene for task fulfillment, artifact

translated_title: Code4Scene：面向3D场景构建与编辑的编程智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 前沿编程智能体现在已经能够编写并执行代码来创建3D环境，但它们是否能可靠地理解3D结构并精确控制场景状态仍不清楚。生成的3D场景是一个持久、可执行的产物：一个看似可信的渲染结果可能掩盖错误的空间关系、相互穿插的物体或意外的修改。我们提出Code4Scene，一个包含190个Unreal Engine案例的基准测试，这些案例基于人工组装的场景构建，在共享的执行接口下，从两个互补的设置来评估编程智能体。构建任务测试从开放式语言规范进行场景级空间推理的能力，其中存在多种有效实现；编辑任务测试对场景状态的精确控制，智能体必须根据参考图像恢复目标场景，同时保留场景中的其他所有内容。Code4Scene不对代码或渲染视图进行评分，而是对生成的引擎原生场景进行评估，衡量其任务完成度与瑕疵。
tldr: 该论文提出Code4Scene基准，通过190个基于Unreal Engine的案例，直接在生成的引擎原生场景上评估编程智能体从语言规范构建3D场景的空间推理能力以及对场景状态进行精确编辑的能力。
en_tdlr: Code4Scene is a benchmark of 190 Unreal Engine cases that evaluates coding agents on 3D scene construction and precise editing by directly assessing the generated engine-native scenes rather than code or rendered views.
